title: People
intro: The people of your organization — the owners and managers in the plan. Everyone can see them, emails included; administrators create, edit and delete people and link them to logins.
notFound: This person does not exist (or was deleted).
loginHint: The account this person signs in with. Optional — an external owner has none.
deleteConflict: This person still owns something or manages a team. Reassign it first.
saveEmailConflict: A person with this email already exists
saveLoginConflict: Another person is already linked to this login
saveInvalid: One or more fields are invalid
saveGone: This person no longer exists — reload the page

validation.emailLength: Email must be at most 254 characters
